item.tib: srid pa rgyas pa'i phrin las 'phang dang srid pa'i rgyal mo'i sig bdar bcas
item.coloph: mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis/ sa lug zla ba bcu yi tshes nyi shar gyim shod zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba nas gter du thon cing / slar lho rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi dbus dkyil pad+ma 'bum rdzong cha zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i snang brnyan dbyibs bar ma gsang sngags drag rdzong byang phyogs kyi rtse mor shing pho byi ba lo yi zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzang por sprul pa'i shog ser la zhal bshus so//
